remaining_findings.title: Shared food/assembly random draw can exclude all new non-build assembly choices
conditions: Communal biomass is below seasonal reserve target
Food gatherTask can successfully assign work
The person is making a new task decision
remaining_findings.mechanism: Food branch returns at chance <0.65 (0.85 under nourish); later assembly needs the same chance <0.4*disposition. Disposition <=1.55 gives threshold <=0.62, a strict subset of the earlier successful-return range.
limits: Food-search failure, meeting the reserve goal or build focus changes this condition.
Current live eligibility and task distribution were not inspected.
remaining_findings.next_check: Bounded choice fixture with bodily needs satisfied, feasible food and active reachable project; trace eligibility before revising arbitration. Preserve urgent survival needs and explicitly review global RNG semantics.

remaining_findings.title: Fixed utility and labor allocation
remaining_findings.finding: Universal cover/storage/work weights 8/6/2; one autonomous active project and 48-tick start delay; other activities compete. Automatic planner lacks advised-assembly food-reserve veto. Current binding state unobserved.
remaining_findings.next_check: Log aggregate blocking reasons, active work, known/feasible candidates and actual material debits before revising preferences.

remaining_findings.title: Fixed construction annulus and persistent occupancy
remaining_findings.finding: Annulus 1.5<r<6 coordinate cells, exclusion distance <1.8 from any structure including ruins. Ideal integer land lattice supports at most 28 centers, fewer with real exclusions.
remaining_findings.next_check: Count free/reachable sites, ruin occupancy and required area; later expose actual site operations and clearance instead of raising mass bound or supplying a house recipe.

remaining_findings.title: Different shelter-capacity conventions and first-match access
remaining_findings.finding: Housing scales capacity by condition; night assignment floors raw capacity; thermal shelter divides raw capacity among nearby people. First selected shelter can fail pathing without trying another.
remaining_findings.next_check: Small route/condition/occupancy fixture; choose and document one usable-capacity/access rule, maintaining real materials and heat costs.

remaining_findings.title: Infant growth and care carriers are incomplete
remaining_findings.finding: Birth draws from camp stocks/water and places the child near camp regardless of gestator location; newborns can take food, drink and walk without a care carrier. Age-independent 35% retention toward 18 kg permits roughly 80-day tissue growth in baseline arithmetic.
remaining_findings.next_check: Define bounded age-dependent growth, local feeding/carrying and caregiver work transfers. Preserve parentage, current pregnancies and total matter; no universal birth quota.

ideal_site_packing.units: integer coordinate-cell centers; not a ground-metre radius claim
ideal_site_packing.method: Enumerate every no-horizontal-adjacency bit mask on each integer y row -5..5. Keep the maximum count for each mask compatible with prior-row vertical and diagonal exclusions. These exclusions exactly match distance<1.8 on the integer grid.

infant_growth.limits: Steady baseline arithmetic; ignores initial hunger phase, food/oxygen shortages, catabolism, interruptions and death. This is represented dry tissue, not complete anatomical mass.
